Q1.rationale: Section 5.6.1 expressly allows disclosure in confidence to a government official or attorney to report a suspected violation of law, so the NDA does not bar such reports without exception.
Q1.label: Contradiction

Q2.rationale: The NDA has no residuals clause permitting use of information retained in unaided memory.
Q2.label: NotMentioned

Q3.rationale: Section 6 bars copying except for copies reasonably required for the Purpose, which allows copying in some circumstances.
Q3.label: Entailment

Q4.rationale: Sections 11 and 56 disclaim damages and provide no fixed sum or penalty for breach.
Q4.label: NotMentioned

Q5.rationale: Section 2 limits use of Confidential Information to the Purpose set forth in the Agreement.
Q5.label: Entailment

Q6.rationale: Section 15 imposes a 24-month post-termination non-compete and section 6 keeps retained copies subject to the restrictions, though the Survival heading is blank.
Q6.label: Entailment

Q7.rationale: Section 9 states that the Disclosing Party retains all rights and the materials remain its property, which is incompatible with any transfer to the Receiving Party.
Q7.label: Contradiction

Q8.rationale: Section 7 requires the Recipient to promptly notify the Disclosing Party of any regulatory, governmental or court request or requirement to disclose.
Q8.label: Entailment

Q9.rationale: The NDA does not say verbal information expressly, but section 8 treats oral transfers of Confidential Information as exports, which implies oral conveyance is covered.
Q9.label: Entailment

Q10.rationale: Section 2 permits access by contract workers, consultants or contractors if authorized in writing and bound by equivalent confidentiality obligations.
Q10.label: Entailment

Q11.rationale: No non-solicitation covenant appears; section 15 is a non-competition restriction only.
Q11.label: NotMentioned

Q12.rationale: The NDA contains no confidentiality term about the fact that the Agreement was negotiated.
Q12.label: NotMentioned

Q13.rationale: Section 10 states that no license or right to the Confidential Information is granted.
Q13.label: Entailment

Q14.rationale: Section 2 restricts only contract workers, consultants and contractors and gives no express permission to share with employees.
Q14.label: NotMentioned

Q15.rationale: Section 13 recognises that the Recipient may receive information from other parties that is similar to the Confidential Information.
Q15.label: Entailment

Q16.rationale: Section 1 expressly includes business information, marketing plans and other non-technical items, so the scope is not limited to technical information.
Q16.label: Contradiction
